pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(PC1, PC2, PC3, hr_mean_diff, log_cda_phasic_max, mean_fix_dur),
    names_to  = "variables",      # name of the new “variable” column
    values_to = "variable_values"      # name of the new “value” column
  )%>%
  mutate(variables = factor(variables, 
                            levels =c("log_cda_phasic_max","hr_mean_diff","PC1","PC2","PC3","mean_fix_dur"),

  group_by(participant,condition, variables)%>%
  summarise_if(is.numeric, mean, na.rm = T)%>%

       aes(x = condition, y = variable_values,
           colour = condition, fill = condition, shape = condition)) +
 
  facet_wrap(~ variables, nrow = 1,scales = "free") +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, fun.args = list(mult=1), 
                 geom="pointrange")+
   geom_boxplot(alpha = .1, colour = "black", notch = TRUE) +
  geom_jitter(width = .2, alpha = .2)+

    xlab("condition")+
     # ylab("transition entropy (bits)")+
  
  ylab("value")+
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +

  p$graphstyle_int+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# with outliers

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 1. build your long, summarised data
df <- dta_emo_sel %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(PC1, PC2, PC3, hr_mean_diff,
                  log_cda_phasic_max, mean_fix_dur),
    names_to  = "variables",
    values_to = "variable_values"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variables = factor(variables,
      levels = c("log_cda_phasic_max","hr_mean_diff",
                 "PC1","PC2","PC3","mean_fix_dur"),
      labels = c("scr phas", "hr diff",
                 "facePC1","facePC2","facePC3","fix dur")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant, condition, variables) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(variable_values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

# 2. compute outliers per facet × condition
outliers <- df %>%
  group_by(variables, condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1  = quantile(mean_value, 0.25),
    Q3  = quantile(mean_value, 0.75),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1
  ) %>%
  filter(mean_value < Q1 - 1.5*IQR |
         mean_value > Q3 + 1.5*IQR) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. plot
df%>%
  subset(participant!= "116")%>%
    subset(participant!= "243")%>%
    subset(participant!= "117")%>%
ggplot( aes(x = condition, y = mean_value,
               colour = condition, fill = condition)) +

  # boxplot without its own outliers
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .1, colour = "black", notch = TRUE) +

  # all points
  geom_jitter(width = .2, size = 2, alpha = .4) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means()+

  # only the outliers, labelled
  geom_text_repel(
    data     = outliers,
    aes(label = participant),
    position = position_jitter(width = .2),
    size     = 3,
    colour   = "black"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ variables, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  xlab("condition") + ylab("value") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
